summary.text: Matt Gile is a Democratic and Vermont Progressive Party candidate for the Vermont House of Representatives, Chittenden-21 District, in the November 3, 2026 general election.

A school librarian in the Winooski School District and former president of the Winooski Education Association, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that his priorities include housing, health care, and limits on immigration enforcement.

paragraphs.text: Gile graduated from Colchester High School and received a bachelor's degree from the University of Vermont in 2008, according to Ballotpedia.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he grew up in Colchester, has worked in libraries throughout his life, and has been the librarian for the Winooski School District for ten years.
He described himself as a labor activist and a member of Vermont NEA, and said he is a former president of the Winooski Education Association.

In the survey, Gile said his campaign messages center on abolishing ICE and keeping federal immigration agents out of schools, hospitals and government buildings, treating housing as a human right with investment in public housing and updated zoning, and raising taxes on high earners.

He said he supports the Prosper Act, which he described as raising income tax on the top 5 percent and adding a surcharge on unearned investment income, and that taxing the wealthy would allow Vermont to implement the Act 48 mandate for universal health care.
He listed Vermont NEA, the Vermont State Employees Association, the Committee of Interns and Residents and Green Mountain DSA as endorsers.
